description:
An OAuth2 application registered in Forgejo, for apps that use Forgejo
as their identity provider. Its credentials (`FORGEJO_CLIENT_ID`,
`FORGEJO_CLIENT_SECRET`, `FORGEJO_URL` — the OIDC issuer) are written to
`secretTargets`.

Forgejo regenerates the client secret on every update and never returns
it again, so the application is only updated when the spec actually
differs, when a target lost the secret, or on a new
`forgejo.weebo.io/rotate-secret` nonce.

confidentialClient.description:
Confidential clients authenticate with their secret; public clients
(SPAs, CLIs) use PKCE only.

deletionPolicy.description: What happens to the Forgejo object when its CR is deleted.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the CR name.

ownerRef.description:
`ForgejoUser` owning the application (typically a `bot`) — the
operator acts as that user through Forgejo's `Sudo` header. Unset:
the operator's admin account. Changing it recreates the application
(new client id), which needs the
`forgejo.weebo.io/allow-disruptive-update: "true"` annotation.

secretTargets.description:
Defaults to one target named after the CR, in its namespace, on the
instance's default `secretStore` backend.

items.description:
Where an emitted secret (generated password or key, OAuth2 credentials,
access token) is written. A CR may list several targets — the same
value is fanned out to each.

backend.description:
`kubernetes` (default) or `vault`. A Vault target reuses the
connection (address, mount, auth) of the instance's
`secretStore.vault`, which must then be set.

name.description:
Kubernetes: the `Secret` name. Vault: names the default path
`<pathPrefix>/<namespace>/<name>` when `path` is unset.

namespace.description:
Kubernetes `Secret` namespace (Vault: the namespace segment of the
default path). Defaults to the CR's own namespace; required on
cluster-scoped CRs.

path.description: Vault only: explicit KV v2 path under the instance's mount.
